lead.t: Definition: A cross-sectional study is an observational research design where data is collected at a single point in time to assess the prevalence of a disease or condition within a population.

snip.t: Definition: A cross-sectional study is an observational research design where data is collected at a single point in time to assess the prevalence of a disease or condition within a population.
Example: "Prevalence of Hypertension among Adults in Nairobi Urban Slums: A Cross-Sectional Study"
